subject: [PATCH v3 07/12] nfsd: recall when a CB_GETATTR reply omits the size

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the NFSv4 callback code where a CB_GETATTR reply without the SIZE attribute would cause the file size to be reported incorrectly, leading to incorrect delegation recalls. The patch adds a new field ncf_cb_bitmap0 to hold word 0 of the reply's bitmap and checks for this condition in nfsd4_cb_getattr_done(). If the SIZE attribute is missing, the callback is failed and the delegation is recalled.
